assessments.finding_note: “孙坚及刘备、关羽、张飞入关”略混淆了汜水关与虎牢关：原文是孙坚先入汜水关，刘备、关羽、张飞攻入虎牢关。
assessments.reason: This is a slight location imprecision from compressing two separate gate events into a general “入关” statement; it preserves the characters’ entry and does not materially change the event or causal chain.
